card.name: Words just before "otherwise"
card.fires_on: The word right before an expected "otherwise" or "other", mostly "unless" in instructions such as "unless otherwise recommended". Also ";" or "or" before "otherwise".

modes.label: unless before otherwise
modes.description: "unless" in a rule or instruction where "otherwise" or "other" comes next.
modes.example: Use MLA format<< unless>> another documentation style has been specified.

modes.label: Linking word before otherwise
modes.description: A semicolon, "or" or a verb that leads into "otherwise" in the next word.
modes.example: If recovered to baseline within 7 days, then resume TEPMETKO at a reduced dose<<;>> otherwise permanently discontinue.

card.writes: It suppresses "otherwise" and its translations, so it appears to mark the spot where "otherwise" is expected next.
card.plain: It lights up on the word just before "otherwise", most often "unless" in "unless otherwise recommended".
